run_lb_interop_test_scenarios: run the script to generate YAML output for all gRPC load balancer interop test scenarios
generate_no_balancer_nx_domain: generate LB interop test configs where the balancer A record returns NX domain for all transport security types
generate_no_balancer_no_data: generate LB interop test configs where the balancer A record returns no data for all transport security types
generate_client_referred_to_backend: generate LB interop test configs for clients referred to a backend with optional short stream and multiple transport security types
generate_client_falls_back_no_backends: generate LB interop test configs where the client falls back because the balancer returns no backends
